websitePlan.name: Website Care + Build
rules: There is no separate website build fee.
New websites are completed progressively through the five included hours each month.
Unused hours expire at the end of each month and do not roll over.
Unfinished approved work can continue with the next month's five-hour allocation.
Additional work is never started without client approval.

additionalWork.rule: The rate depends on complexity and all overage work requires advance client approval.

socialMedia.startingPrice: $50 per month in addition to the website plan
socialMedia.rule: The final social media fee is adjusted for the number of platforms, posting frequency, content needs, and workload.

virtualAssistance.summary: Custom virtual assistance for administration, communication, research, organization, systems, workflows, content support, and project follow-through.
virtualAssistance.pricing: Scoped to the work requested. HSST confirms the rate before work begins.

assistantRules: Never invent a price, discount, guarantee, delivery date, or service commitment.
Explain the five-hour monthly allocation and approval requirement whenever discussing website timing or overages.
If the answer is not in this file, offer to connect the visitor with Brandon.
Keep answers concise, practical, and friendly.
